prompt:
ONE original NEW square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of RADHA, Hindu goddess of love and devotion, queen of Goloka and Braj, worshiped as supreme being in Radha Vallabha and Haridasi. Create a monumental SACRED DEVOTIONAL IMAGE, not a photograph of an ordinary woman and absolutely not a woman in a garden. [radha-c01, radha-c03, radha-c07, radha-c08]
ANATOMY: exactly ONE adult human-form divine queen; ONE head, TWO eyes, TWO arms, TWO hands, TWO legs. Full opaquely clothed body in heavy crimson-and-antique-gold robes with covered shoulders and torso, opaque skirt covering both legs. Enormous broad intricate royal gold crown fully contained within the square, crown about as wide as her shoulders; serious dignified compassionate face. Crown and clothing are editorial queenly representation rather than asserted source iconography. [radha-c01, radha-c08]
MOMENT: Turn and sweep diagonally through a commanding RASA DANCE directly above the viewer; full body twists actively, one knee bends beneath fabric and one foot supports the turn, one arm reaches outward with a classical open dance hand and the other pulls the heavy opaque robe into a great diagonal sweep. The head turns down to confront the viewer with unwavering devotional authority. She is queen of Raslila and fond of rasa dance. Not a reaching-hand beauty portrait, not posed standing, not stopping traffic, not smiling. [radha-c17, radha-c03]
POWER: NO documented visible physical magical power, so NO magical beams, halos, glowing skin or luminous energy. Her divinity is expressed through hierarchical devotional composition: enormous sacred queen above a tiny subordinate royal assembly, royal crown and sacred dance. This monumental symbolic scale is an editorial visual language for divine queenhood and supreme reverence, NOT a claim that she has literal giant anatomy. [radha-c07, radha-c08]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low worm-eye view from the floor of the tiny court looking nearly straight upward at the dancing queen. Radha fills the upper EIGHTY-FIVE percent of the square from her complete crown to her dancing feet. Her robe forms a strong dramatic diagonal. Tiny worshipful attendants and minute royal court steps occupy ONLY the very bottom ten percent under her, unmistakably subordinate to the divine presence. She visually towers twenty times larger than any attendant, explicitly symbolic sacred scale. Keep the whole crown and foot gesture inside the frame. Do not make the woman human scale.
LIGHT & WEATHER: DARK low-key scene, deep black walnut shadows, one brilliant warm backlight through a distant narrow high doorway behind the sweeping robe, edge-light gold crown and fabric folds; no circular halo, no light emitted by her. Strong shadow across one side of her face; antique gold and deep crimson dominant. No sunny garden, no natural greenery, no flowers, no landscape.
SURFACE: genuine painterly devotional fantasy illustration with textured brushwork, heavy woven cloth, dark weathered gilding, incised crown ornaments without letters, shadowed stone court steps. Do not make a glamour photo, fashion campaign, costumed actress or editorial photograph.
SETTING: editorial symbolic sacred royal court of Goloka/Braj below Radha, based on her queenly realm and the reverence of traditions worshiping her as supreme being. A few tiny devotees bow at the very bottom, huge dark architectural masses frame the sides, architectural details are editorial not documentary. [radha-c07, radha-c08]
MOOD: overwhelming divine sovereignty and sublime compassion, viewer feels compelled to bow before a sacred queen in motion. Respect living Hindu religion: awe-inspiring, never monstrous, hostile or sexualized.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: exactly one original square image; no text, lettering, pseudo-script, logo, frame, border, watermark or artist signature; no extra heads, arms, hands, fingers, eyes or wings; no weapons; no film/game/anime/comic designs; no nudity or gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, magic beams, runes or energy ribbons. NO GARDEN, NO FLOWERS, NO SUNNY WOMAN PORTRAIT.
